text: COMPLETION AND RETENTION 4 in 10 students drop out of college. About 2M a year leave with student loan debt, but no degree to help pay for that debt. 1 in 3 first-year students don't return for year two. 60% of students don't finish a bachelor's in 4 years, and about 40% still haven't in 6. Time-to-degree keeps stretching. National Center for Education Statistics (NCES / IPEDS)
HIGHER WITHDRAWAL RATES 10–15% for lower income and underprepared students in online courses. Columbia University
EARNINGS AND EMPLOYMENT $1M less in lifetime earnings without a degree, and twice as likely to be unemployed. Pew Research Center
